premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A water-lifting device saves hours of labor but needs wood, metal, and frequent repair.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: It helps some farms and reveals maintenance costs.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The village advances more slowly with fewer new materials.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: Workers and farmers redesign the plan so the savings are shared more fairly.
